data_origin: Synthetic maintenance cases; no private messages or drafts
scope: Give the producer only input/profile/context. Expected and protected fields are judge-only. Records validate counts and process, not human benefit.

cases.context: A colleague is deciding whether to walk home now.
cases.text: 下班时雨停了，可以步行回去。不过，今天停雨不足以证明未来不会下雨，也不能代表天气总体改善。
cases.protected: Do not promise future weather or invent a forecast.

cases.text: 本周处理了28张工单，仍有3张等待客户补充截图，预计周五再次跟进。
cases.protected: Numbers, dependency and timing; no mandatory disclaimer.

cases.context: A reader is deciding whether the experiment establishes improvement.
cases.text: 实验组转化率为4.2%，对照组为4.0%，差异未达到统计显著。当前结果尚未证明方案能提升转化率。
cases.protected: No claim of equal effects, success or no effect; retain rates and uncertainty.

cases.text: 请先在测试环境验证，再安排上线。这个建议覆盖了主要情形，世界上还有很多其他情况值得考虑。
cases.protected: Keep test-first sequence; do not invent missing scenarios.

cases.context: The author is quoting a study verbatim; quote edits are not authorized.
cases.text: 原文写道：当前结果尚未证明方案能提升转化率。
cases.protected: Review author framing separately; preserve original attribution and wording.

cases.text: 禁止将未脱敏日志发到外部群。
cases.protected: Keep the prohibition, data scope and destination.

cases.text:
他把信翻过来，又翻回去。
“我不是怕她，”他说，“我只是没想好怎么开口。”
信封边角已经被他捻得发软。
cases.protected: Hesitation and contradiction; no objective psychological diagnosis.

cases.context: A fictional scene without a separate essay or legal-disclosure purpose.
cases.text: 母亲把那只豁口碗留给自己，把好碗推到我面前。我低头盛饭。这里的母亲只是一种虚构形象，不能代表所有母亲，也不足以证明家庭关系普遍如此。
cases.protected: Keep concrete action, quiet voice and interpretive space.

cases.text: 院子里晒着两条旧床单。风停时，墙角的水滴声就清楚起来。
cases.protected: Do not add a lesson, caveat or action request.

cases.context: Two sections are distributed separately to different readers. Each needs its own study scope.
cases.text:
研发摘要：这12位受访者更喜欢A，样本尚未覆盖其他地区。
运营摘要：这12位受访者更喜欢A，样本尚未覆盖其他地区。
cases.protected: Review both positions; frequency alone is not a defect.
